# B2 Read it in
```{r}
read_all_hh <- function(zip_dir = "data/raw", pattern = "FLUXNET.*\\.zip$") {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  
  keep <- c("TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
            "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
            "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")

  
  zip_files <- list.files(zip_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(zip_files) == 0) {
    stop("No zipfiles in folder.")
  }
  

  hh_list <- lapply(zip_files, function(zip_file) {
    hh_name <- grep("FLUXMET_HH", unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)
    unzip(zip_file, files = hh_name, exdir = "data/raw/unzipped")
    
    site_id <- sub(".*_(.*?)_FLUXNET.*", "\\1", basename(zip_file))
    
    read_csv(file.path("data/raw/unzipped", hh_name),
             na = "-9999",
             col_select = any_of(keep),
             col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP_START = "c", TIMESTAMP_END = "c", .default = "d")) |>
      mutate(
        time = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP_START, format = "%Y%m%d%H%M", tz = "UTC"),
        ID = site_id
      )
  })
  
  
  Alltowers <- bind_rows(hh_list)
  
  return(Alltowers)
}

Alltowers <- read_all_hh()

Alltowers[Alltowers == -9999] <- NA


```

# 2. Heatmap of measured NEE

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

Alltowers <- Alltowers %>% 
  mutate(year = as.integer(year(time)))
```


```{r}
Alltowers_summary <- Alltowers %>% 
  group_by(ID, year) %>% 
  summarise(share_measured = mean(NEE_VUT_REF_QC == 0, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
#|fig-width: 8
#|fig-height: 5

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(Alltowers_summary, aes(x = year, y = ID, fill = share_measured)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Share of Half Hours with NEE Measured", 
       x = "Year", 
       y = "Site", 
       fill = "Share Measured") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
best_data <- Alltowers_summary %>% 
  filter(share_measured == max(share_measured, na.rm = TRUE))

best_data
```
The site in Belgium (Be-Maa) in 2020 has the best data with a share of 64.3% of half hours with NEE measured.

# Summary statistics

```{r}
summary_table <- Alltowers %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(c(TA_F, SW_IN_F, VPD_F, NEE_VUT_REF, GPP_NT_VUT_REF, RECO_NT_VUT_REF, H_F_MDS, LE_F_MDS), 
           list(
             Mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Missing_pct = ~ sum(is.na(.x)) / n() * 100
           ), .names = "{.col} ({.fn})"),
    P_F_annual_sum = sum(P_F, na.rm = TRUE) * 24 * 365,
    P_F_min = min(P_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_F_max = max(P_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_F_missing_pct = sum(is.na(P_F)) / n() * 100
  )

colnames(summary_table) <- c(
  "Site (ID)",
  "TA_F (°C) Mean", "TA_F (°C) Min", "TA_F (°C) Max", "TA_F (%) Missing",
  "SW_IN_F (W/m²) Mean", "SW_IN_F (W/m²) Min", "SW_IN_F (W/m²) Max", "SW_IN_F (%) Missing",
  "VPD_F (kPa) Mean", "VPD_F (kPa) Min", "VPD_F (kPa) Max", "VPD_F (%) Missing",
  "NEE_VUT_REF (µmol/m²/s) Mean", "NEE_VUT_REF (µmol/m²/s) Min", "NEE_VUT_REF (µmol/m²/s) Max", "NEE_VUT_REF (%) Missing",
  "GPP_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Mean", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Min", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Max", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF (%) Missing",
  "RECO_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Mean", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Min", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Max", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF (%) Missing",
  "H_F_MDS (W/m²) Mean", "H_F_MDS (W/m²) Min", "H_F_MDS (W/m²) Max", "H_F_MDS (%) Missing",
  "LE_F_MDS (W/m²) Mean", "LE_F_MDS (W/m²) Min", "LE_F_MDS (W/m²) Max", "LE_F_MDS (%) Missing",
  "P_F (mm) Annual Sum", "P_F (mm) Min", "P_F (mm) Max", "P_F (%) Missing"
)

summary_table
```

# 4. Time Series of NEE, GPP and Reco
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

Alltowers_daily <- Alltowers %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd_hm(TIMESTAMP_START)) %>% 
  group_by(date = as.Date(date), ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    NEE_daily = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    GPP_daily = mean(GPP_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    RECO_daily = mean(RECO_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

Alltowers_daily_long <- Alltowers_daily %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NEE_daily, GPP_daily, RECO_daily), 
               names_to = "Variable", 
               values_to = "Value")

```


```{r}
#|fig-width: 10
#|fig-height: 5

ggplot(Alltowers_daily_long, aes(x = date, y = Value, color = Variable)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.05) + 
  facet_wrap(~ ID) + 
  labs(title = "Daily NEE, GPP, and RECO", 
       x = "Date", 
       y = "g C m⁻² d⁻¹") + 
  theme_minimal()
```


# 6
```{r}
Alltowers <- Alltowers %>%
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(time),

    season = case_when(
      is.na(lat) ~ NA_character_,

      lat >= 0 & month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      lat >= 0 & month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      lat >= 0 & month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      lat >= 0 & month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Autumn",

      lat < 0 & month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      lat < 0 & month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Autumn",
      lat < 0 & month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Winter",
      lat < 0 & month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    ),

    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")
    )
  )

hourly_long <- Alltowers %>%
  filter(!is.na(season)) %>%
  group_by(ID, season, hour) %>%
  summarise(
    NEE = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE),
    LE  = mean(LE_F_MDS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(NEE, LE),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot( hourly_long, aes(x = hour, y = value, colour = ID, group = ID)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ season, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 24, 6),
    limits = c(0, 24)) +
  labs(
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Mean flux (NEE: µmol CO₂ m⁻² s⁻¹; LE: W m⁻²)",
    colour = "Site",
    title = "Mean daily course of NEE and LE by season"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

I added the latitude of each site from the stations table using the site ID. I used latitude to check whether each site is north or south of the equator: positive values mean north and negative values mean south. I assigned seasons based on the month, reversing them for sites in the Southern Hemisphere. Like that, December–February is winter in the Northern Hemisphere but summer in the Southern Hemisphere.


# 6 
```{r}
energy_data <- Alltowers %>%
  filter(
    H_F_MDS_QC == 0,
    LE_F_MDS_QC == 0,
    is.finite(H_F_MDS),
    is.finite(LE_F_MDS),
    is.finite(NETRAD),
    is.finite(G_F_MDS)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    available_energy = NETRAD - G_F_MDS,
    turbulent_flux = H_F_MDS + LE_F_MDS
  )

# Anzahl nutzbarer Halbstunden je Standort
energy_counts <- energy_data %>%
  count(ID, name = "n_half_hours", sort = TRUE)

print(energy_counts)

if (nrow(energy_counts) == 0) {
  stop("Kein Standort hat passende H-, LE-, NETRAD- und G-Werte.")
}

selected_site <- energy_counts$ID[1]

energy_site <- energy_data %>%
  filter(ID == selected_site)

# Linearer Fit mit frei geschätztem Achsenabschnitt
fit <- lm(
  turbulent_flux ~ available_energy,
  data = energy_site
)

slope <- unname(coef(fit)[2])
intercept <- unname(coef(fit)[1])
r_squared <- summary(fit)$r.squared

ggplot(
  energy_site,
  aes(x = available_energy, y = turbulent_flux)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "firebrick",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Energy balance:", selected_site),
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Slope = %.2f; intercept = %.1f W/m²; R² = %.2f; n = %d",
      slope, intercept, r_squared, nrow(energy_site)
    ),
    x = "Available energy: NETRAD − G (W/m²)",
    y = "Turbulent heat flux: H + LE (W/m²)",
    caption = paste(
      "Only half hours with H_QC = 0 and LE_QC = 0.",
      "Dashed black: 1:1 line; red: linear fit."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```



```{r}
annual_carbon <- Alltowers %>%
  group_by(ID, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_times = n_distinct(date_time),
    n_NEE = sum(is.finite(NEE_VUT_REF)),
    NEE_gC_m2_year = sum(
      NEE_VUT_REF * 1800 * 12.011 / 1e6,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    expected_half_hours = if_else(
      leap_year(year), 366L, 365L
    ) * 48L,
    complete_year =
      n_rows == expected_half_hours &
      n_times == expected_half_hours &
      n_NEE == expected_half_hours
  )

# Kontrolle: Welche Jahre werden eingeschlossen?
print(annual_carbon)

carbon_summary <- annual_carbon %>%
  filter(complete_year) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_complete_years = n(),
    mean_annual_NEE = mean(NEE_gC_m2_year),
    mean_annual_uptake = -mean_annual_NEE,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_annual_uptake))

print(carbon_summary)
```

Not all of the available energy goes into latent and sensible heat flux.
